licenseNote: Self-authored rule. Mikan (mikanani.me) BT 资源聚合站，按日文/罗马音标题搜索。资源发现源，不提供在线播放地址（parse 返回空）。
search: function search(kw, page) { function dec(s) { return s.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/'/g, String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/&#(\d+);/g, function(_, n) { return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(n, 10)); }); } try { var url = 'https://mikanani.me/Home/Search?searchstr=' + encodeURIComponent(kw); return fetch(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return []; var html = r.body; var startIdx = html.indexOf('class="list-inline an-ul" style="margin-top:20px;"'); var body = startIdx >= 0 ? html.slice(startIdx) : html; var items = []; var seen = {}; var re = /<a href="\/Home\/Bangumi\/(\d+)"[^>]*>([^]*?)<\/a>/g; var m; while ((m = re.exec(body)) !== null && items.length < 40) { var id = m[1]; if (seen[id]) continue; seen[id] = true; var block = m[2]; var tM = /<div class="an-text"[^>]*title="([^"]*)"/.exec(block) || /<div class="an-text"[^>]*>([^<]+)/.exec(block); var cM = /data-src="([^"]+)"/.exec(block); if (!tM) continue; var title = dec(tM[1]).trim(); if (!title) continue; items.push({ title: title, url: 'https://mikanani.me/Home/Bangumi/' + id, cover: (cM && cM[1]) || '', extra: {} }); } return items; }).catch(function(e) { throw new Error('mikan search: ' + e.message); }); } catch (e) { throw new Error('mikan search: ' + e.message); } }
detail: function detail(url) { try { var m = /Bangumi\/(\d+)/.exec(url || ''); if (!m) return { title: '未知', cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; return fetch('https://mikanani.me/Home/Bangumi/' + m[1], { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return { title: '未知', cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; var html = r.body; var tM = /<div class="bangumi-title"[^>]*>([^<]+)/.exec(html) || /<title>([^<]+)/.exec(html); var ogM = /property="og:image"[^>]*content="([^"]+)"/.exec(html); return { title: (tM && tM[1]) || '未知', cover: (ogM && ogM[1]) || null, description: null, extra: {} }; }).catch(function() { return { title: '未知', cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; }); } catch (e) { return { title: '未知', cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; } }
chapter: function chapter(detailUrl) { try { return fetch(detailUrl, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return []; var html = r.body; var items = []; var seen = {}; var re = /<a[^>]*href="(magnet:\?xt=[^"]+)"[^>]*>([^]*?)<\/a>/g; var m; var idx = 0; while ((m = re.exec(html)) !== null && items.length < 300) { var href = m[1]; if (seen[href]) continue; seen[href] = true; idx += 1; var tM = /class="episode-title[^"]*"[^>]*>([^<]+)/.exec(m[2]) || /class="magnet-link[^"]*"[^>]*>([^<]+)/.exec(m[2]); items.push({ id: String(idx), title: (tM && tM[1].trim()) || ('EP' + idx), url: href, index: idx }); } return items; }).catch(function() { return []; }); } catch (e) { return []; } }
parse: function parse(chapterUrl) { try { return { urls: [], kind: 'video' }; } catch (e) { return { urls: [], kind: 'video' }; } }
